utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a screwdriver, a hammer, and a drill for the repair drive. Just tell me what you need first.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, perfect — that’s a great start. I’m a little fuzzy, but if you send me the missing list, I’ll see what else I can round up for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it — I’ll send over the missing list now, and I can keep an eye out for anything else useful for Saturday too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only been hearing scraps too, but it sounds like it’s still coming together nicely. If I hear anything concrete they still need, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Nell — just send me the first concrete repair item when you hear it, and I’ll jump on it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Absolutely — I’ll pass along the first specific repair need I hear, pronto.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Did we settle the repair drive list yet, or should I wait for Hana to check it?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’d wait for Hana to confirm the list, and I’m still good to help with any small fixes Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I’ll wait for Hana’s confirmation, and thanks for being on small fixes Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great — so it’s still on track, and you’ll let me know if the list changes, right?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep you posted if anything changes, and I’m still spreading the word for this Saturday’s repair drive. Send anyone with a wobbly chair, finicky lamp, or other fix-up to us!

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just confirming — it’s definitely still on for Saturday, right?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little, but I need to keep things low-key right now.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No worries, Uli — keeping it low-key is totally fine. I’ll keep the repair drive simple and let you know if there’s a small, quiet way to help.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Jules. Just let me know if there’s something small and quiet I can do.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Tess — the plan is still 9:00 AM, and I’ll keep the pickup and drop-off clear so nothing gets missed. If anything shifts, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, Eli — I’ll pass that along and keep everyone in the loop. Just send me any changes right away, and I’ll make sure the word gets out.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Will do — I’ll keep it steady at 9:00 AM and send any changes right away. Thanks for helping keep everyone in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Faye — I’m still gathering the last few details for the repair drive, so if you hear anything about tools or timing, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely — I’ll keep it around school drop-off and let you know if I hear anything about tools or timing.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Faye — that timing helps a lot. If you hear anything about the tool list, just pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Dane — that works. Please start at the community center, load the boxes, and then take the tools over to Mrs. Patel’s garage.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Got it — I’m on my way to the community center now, and then I’ll take the tools over to Mrs. Patel’s garage.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, thanks Dane — I’ve got the community center and Mrs. Patel’s garage noted. Let me know when you’re on your way with the tools.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks — just keep me posted on the pickup time, and I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll keep you posted on the pickup time and send any updates as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Vik — that works for me. Just let me know the pickup time when it’s set, and I’ll plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo — could you keep an eye out for basic tool kits, duct tape, spare lightbulbs, batteries, and any donated extension cords or a hand truck? Also, quick update: the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely, Rosa — I’ll keep tracking those supplies and note the move to Sunday at the community center. I’ll let you know right away if I spot tool kits, duct tape, bulbs, batteries, extension cords, or a hand truck.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo — that’s perfect. I really appreciate you keeping an eye out and letting me know if anything turns up.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Noah — I’m checking the list details first, so I want to make sure we only include items we can actually repair. What items should go on the repair drive list?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — let’s keep it to the items we can actually fix. If you send me the latest list, I’ll point folks to the first repair that needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Noah — I’ll send the latest list over, and then we can mark the first repair to tackle.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Leo — I heard the repair drive’s coming along nicely. I’ll keep an eye out while I’m out running errands, and if I spot any useful supplies I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Ira — that’d help a lot. Just let me know if you spot anything useful, and I’ll keep sorting the donations here.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: You got it, Leo — I’ll keep an ear out and swing by with anything useful I find while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hi Oren — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. I can keep an eye out for tool kits or a hand truck, and I’m ready to pitch in once you’ve got the details sorted.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, perfect — thanks, Sam. I’m a little fuzzy on the exact list, but I’ll check my notes and see what’s still missing, then I can tell you what to keep an eye out for.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Oren — just send me the updated list when you’ve got it, and I’ll start looking for the tool kits and hand truck right away.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure thing, Kira—I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and let you know if I hear anything new about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, so you’ll tell me right away if you hear anything new, right?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Absolutely — if I hear anything new on my errands, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Cleo — just send me the pickup time when you have it, and I’m good on drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely, Pia — I’ll confirm the pickup time as soon as I have it and keep you posted if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Cleo — just send the pickup time when you have it, and we’re all set on drop-off.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Sure — just send me the repair drive location and time, and I’ll note it so I can share it accurately.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I don’t have the location and time on me yet — can you send the first repair item instead?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Absolutely — the first repair item is loading the boxes by the community center, then dropping the tools off at Mrs. Patel’s garage.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’m still happy to help with the repair drive. What’s the next thing you need me to handle?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Leo — I’ll keep the list updated and send you the latest needs as they come in, and you can help spread the word around the block.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I’ll spread the word around the block and let you know if anyone can help.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’m spreading the word fast, and I’ll tell folks the repair drive is this Saturday at 9:00 AM. If you know anyone with a wobbly chair, finicky lamp, or anything else needing a fix, send them by!

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Quinn — I’ll stick with Saturday at 9:00 AM and help keep the drop-off clear. If anything shifts, I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Eli — thanks for keeping the drop-off clear and spreading any updates fast. I’ll keep sending folks your way if they’ve got something that needs fixing!

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: We’ve mostly got it settled — I’m just waiting on Hana for the final check, but the tools and timing are already lined up. If you want, I can share the current list now.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, please share the current list — I want to check the details one more time before we finalize it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll send the current list over now, and we can tweak anything you spot before we lock it in.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Not yet — I think we should wait for Hana to finish checking the list before we lock it in. If you want, I can follow up with her.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Ah, got it — let’s wait on Hana’s check before we lock anything in. If you hear back, send me the updated list and I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Will do — I’ll send the updated list as soon as Hana finishes checking it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Tess — I’m here now. What should I do first for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Dane — thanks for jumping in. First, could you help me round up a few more volunteers and see if anyone has tools or supplies we can borrow?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Absolutely — I’ll round up a few more volunteers and ask around for any tools or supplies we can borrow.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Rosa — I’m here for the repair drive. Tell me what still needs doing, and I’ll help keep track.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — could you help keep a running list of volunteers and any donated supplies? I’ve moved the repair drive to Sunday at the community center, and I’m getting the flyer and sign-up sheet ready.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely, Rosa — I’ll keep a running list of volunteers and donated supplies, and note the Sunday change at the community center too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Nell — I’ve got a wrench set and a soldering iron I can bring, and I’ll keep an ear out for the first repair item too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that’d be really helpful, Gus — I’ve only been hearing bits and pieces, so I’m glad you can bring those. If I hear anything concrete they still need, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Nell — I appreciate it. Just send me the first repair item when you hear it, and I’ll be ready.
